items.exampleEn: My mother worries when I come home late.
items.exampleZh: 我晚回家時，媽媽會擔心。

items.audioEn: I am not interested in sports. I like to read alone.
items.audioZh: 我對運動沒興趣，我喜歡一個人看書。

items.sentenceEn: Don't worry. I can help you.
My wish is to see the sea.

items.stemEn: I am ____ in history. I read history books every day.
items.stemZh: 我對歷史有興趣，每天都讀歷史書。

items.stemEn: My ____ is to become a singer one day.
items.stemZh: 我的夢想是有一天成為歌手。

items.passageEn: Tom lives alone in a small flat. He has one big dream: to be a writer. He finds people interesting, so he writes stories about them. His only worry is money. But his first book sells well, and his mother gives him a big smile.
items.passageZh: Tom 一個人住在一間小公寓裡。他有一個大夢想：當作家。他覺得人很有趣，所以寫關於人的故事。他唯一的煩惱是錢。不過他的第一本書賣得很好，他媽媽給了他一個大大的笑容。

questions.questionZh: Tom 唯一的煩惱是什麼？

referenceEn: I am very interested in science.
rubricZh: 「對⋯有興趣」用 be interested in（例如 interested in science）
描述人的感受用 interested，不寫 interesting

referenceEn: I don't like to be home alone.
I don't like being at home alone.
rubricZh: alone 常放在句尾（例如 be home alone）
like 後面接 to＋原形、動名詞都正確（例如 like to be、like being）
